summary: A trial bot using Claude reviews new Apache Spark pull requests, posting only advisory comments without approvals or LGTM. The new source supports pushdown of column pruning, filters, limits, aggregates, and partitioning, and writes through ADBC bulk ingest. The discussion addresses an issue where Istio’s STRICT mTLS mode rejects traffic to pod IPs not backed by a Service, causing executor-to-executor communication failures in Spark. The discussion proposes a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions that can run in any language via external workers, enabling Spark Connect to support UDFs in Go, Rust, Swift, .NET, and more.
